lines.en: I do not walk, I hang beneath the leaf
When the wind comes, I sway whole
A thread of silk hangs me here
Something moves inside, unseen outside

lines.zh: 这是我最安静的一段路
lines.en: This is the quietest stretch of my road

lines.zh: 我绕着丝转半圈，又转回来
lines.en: I turn half a loop on the silk and back
The leaf rocks, so do I
I am heavier now, the silk pulls tight

lines.zh: 平原的风每天都一个方向
lines.en: The plains wind blows one way every day

lines.zh: 我在叶背上待着，哪儿也不去
lines.en: I stay on the leaf's back, going nowhere
A ring of gold dots on my shell
I am slowly losing sight of outside
My old skin still hangs below

lines.zh: 这一步不用走，等着就行
lines.en: No walking needed here, only waiting

lines.zh: 我在里面换了一副身体
lines.en: Inside I am changing bodies
The harder the shell, the less I can move
I hang, perfectly still
This shell is my own work

lines.zh: 叶脉的影子从我身上过
lines.en: The vein shadows cross over me
It is cramped inside, and safe
I hear birds outside
The shell looks like a dead leaf
I can eat nothing now
I count how many days remain

lines.zh: 雨打在叶子上，我晃了晃
lines.en: Rain hits the leaf and I rock
My wings are folded inside

lines.zh: 外面的世界都隔着这一层
lines.en: The world outside is behind this layer
I am in no hurry to come out

lines.zh: 你凑近了看，我就在这片叶背面
lines.en: You lean in to look, and I am here under the leaf

lines.zh: 我像一片干叶，你分不出来
lines.en: I look like a dry leaf, you cannot tell

lines.zh: 壳上的金点，是我最后的样子
lines.en: The gold dots are my last shape
Do not pinch, I am still growing in here
Pick me off and it is over

lines.zh: 我看不见你的脸，只看见影子
lines.en: I cannot see your face, only a shadow
You shook this leaf

lines.zh: 再等几天，我就不在这儿了
lines.en: A few more days and I will not be here

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的丝
lines.en: Your shadow covers my silk thread
Stand back and I will be calmer
A mark on the shell
I was jolted inside
The silk holding me has slackened
I was rocked for a long while
It is very stuffy in here
The pain is only now returning

lines.zh: 这一下，我可能出不来了
lines.en: After that, I may not come out
The shell split, and it is too soon
I hear my own shell creaking
Do not knock on this shell
I do not eat now

lines.zh: 叶子就在旁边，我也吃不了
lines.en: The leaf is right here and I cannot eat it

lines.zh: 你把东西举给我，可我没嘴
lines.en: You hold it out, but I have no mouth for it
This shell is sealed shut

lines.zh: 这一层皮下面，什么都不进
lines.en: Nothing gets in under this skin
All I need is a little time

lines.zh: 你的东西放远些，会招虫
lines.en: Put that away, it will draw insects

lines.zh: 我要到化成蝶那天才吃
lines.en: I will not eat until I am a butterfly

lines.zh: 你闻不到我的，我闻得到你的
lines.en: You cannot smell me, I can smell you
Do not leave it under the leaf, it will dampen

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我被甩了半圈
lines.en: The leaf swung and threw me half a turn
My silk nearly broke

lines.zh: 你碰的是叶子，不是我的壳
lines.en: You touched the leaf, not my shell
I am pressed to the leaf's back and cannot move

lines.zh: 这一下，让我整个人打转
lines.en: That set me spinning
A mark is knocked into the shell

lines.zh: 别抖，这一根丝撑着全部
lines.en: Do not shake it, one thread holds everything

lines.zh: 你从我下面走过，风都变了
lines.en: You passed beneath and even the air changed
I swayed a long while before stopping
Touch again and I drop

lines.zh: 我封在壳里，什么也做不了
lines.en: I am sealed in a shell and can do nothing
Ask again when I am out

lines.zh: 那时候我大概只活几天
lines.en: Even then I will live only days
Right now there is only this shell
I do not even have wings yet
My shape is still changing
Do not wait, the bloom will not wait

lines.zh: 我心里只有一件事，出去
lines.en: There is only one thing on my mind, getting out

lines.zh: 外面有风，就够我飞一阵
lines.en: Out there the wind will carry me a while
It is very cramped in this layer
I cannot hold anything
I have no hands, only a shell

lines.zh: 东西落在我旁边，压着丝
lines.en: It fell by me and weighs on the silk

lines.zh: 我看不见下面，只能感觉到
lines.en: I cannot see below, only feel

lines.zh: 你把它拿走，我这边就轻了
lines.en: Take it away and my side feels lighter
No hands come out of this shell; let it fall
It rests on my shell, cold
The leaf is bowed under it
When you go, I am still here

lines.zh: 这东西要是留下来，会招蚂蚁
lines.en: If it stays, ants will come
I felt the shadow
I cannot move from here

lines.zh: 我的壳和叶子一个颜色
lines.en: My shell is the same color as the leaf

lines.zh: 有东西在我下方停下来
lines.en: Something has stopped below me
I pull myself tighter
The silk holds, I will not fall yet

lines.zh: 我看不见它，可我知道它在
lines.en: I cannot see it, but I know it is there

lines.zh: 叶子上没有别的东西可以躲
lines.en: There is nothing else on this leaf to hide behind
You are below me and have not left

lines.zh: 这个时候，我什么也做不了
lines.en: At this moment I can do nothing
It is still about

lines.zh: 我在壳里数外面的脚步
lines.en: Inside my shell I count the footsteps outside
It is getting stuffy inside the shell

lines.zh: 它的呼吸让叶子微微动
lines.en: Its breathing makes the leaf tremble

lines.zh: 我听着它每一步的响动
lines.en: I follow every sound of its steps
One gust and I am at a new angle
The stalk was chewed recently
The louder it gets, the stiller I must be

lines.zh: 这一层壳挡得住爪子吗
lines.en: Will this shell stop a claw
A while more and it will go
I sway once; that counts as striking back
The shell takes a knock, muffled
I flex the silk once
That only made me sway
You are knocking on the shell, I hear it
The shell is hard, your nail will hurt
I drop and hit your shoulder
I cannot even push

lines.zh: 这一下，是我最后的办法
lines.en: That was my last resort
A crack, and I am not ready
A small shell now hangs under the leaf
I have fixed myself here

lines.zh: 最后一层旧皮蜕在旁边
lines.en: The last old skin is shed beside me

lines.zh: 平原的叶子背面，很安静
lines.en: The underside of a plains leaf is quiet
A strand of silk holds me up

lines.zh: 我从毛虫的样子变成了这个
lines.en: From the caterpillar shape to this
The shell is fresh, not yet faded
I seal myself in

lines.zh: 叶子弯了一点，因为我在
lines.en: The leaf bends a little because I am here
These days can only be waited out
The shell softened and I shrank inward

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下来，摔在土上
lines.en: I came off the leaf and hit the soil
Water seeped in and I was smothered

lines.zh: 一股力把我从丝上扯下来
lines.en: A force tore me off the silk

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过叶子，从我旁边过
lines.en: An arrow went through the leaf, past me

lines.zh: 壳里的空气一下子凉了
lines.en: The air inside the shell turned cold

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我等太久了
lines.en: I do not eat, but I have waited too long
At the thunder I shook inside the shell
There is no leaf here to hang from
